4388.title: Streaming timeline history reset
4388.rootCauseOneLine: Updated omitted-row marker forces latest-only history; real sentinel auto-loader reloads it repeatedly.
4388.proposedFix: Reconcile bounded older-row changes without wholesale history reset; verify projection, deltas and scroll anchoring.
caveats: Projected rows, snapshots and reload delay are synthetic; full HTTP/controller/provider path untested.
No production flicker rate, latency or scroll-jump measurement.
